title: Kth Largest Sum in a Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree and a positive integer k, find the kth largest sum of node values at the same level.
statement: Given a binary tree and a positive integer k, find the kth largest sum of node values at the same level. If fewer than k levels exist, return -1. Nodes on the same level are those with equal distance from the root.
constraints: Compute the sum of node values at each depth of a nonempty binary tree.
Return the kth largest level sum.
Return -1 when the tree has fewer than k levels.
